name: Click
source:
Click has incredible magical powers, and an impressive amount of formal titles to match! She comes from a universe where crows have become the dominant life form instead of humans. I know her from my Magic class, where she seems to take the lead in organization. She seems to like Nice people.

[From in-game profile]
